data.title: SLS Residences
data.about:
Experience the pinnacle of luxury at SLS Residences Palm Jumeirah by Roya . Discover 113 meticulously designed units, including 2 and 3 bedroom simplexes, 3 and 4 bedroom duplexes, and exquisite penthouses. For those seeking privacy, the ground floor offers 13 exclusive residences with private gardens.

Perched atop the West Crescent, these ultra-luxury residences by Roya Lifestyle Developments and managed by Ennismore capture the essence of ocean waves with their stylish interiors and abstract shapes.

With exclusive beach access and panoramic views of Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah, SLS Residences Palm Jumeirah is a symbol of modern luxury living, seamlessly blending iconic architecture with coastal elegance. Experience refined living at SLS Residences Palm Jumeirah by SLS by Roya.

characteristics_module.title: Where Elegance meets Spaciousness
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Discover meticulously crafted 2, 3 & 4 bedroom luxury apartments and duplexes with exclusive designs.
  • Experience the allure of a brand-new residential development by Roya Lifestyle on Palm Jumeirah.
  • This ground plus 9-story residential project offers an array of private facilities for residents.
  • Enjoy the luxury of a clubhouse and infinity swimming pool-like amenities for your relaxation.
  • Retail therapy, a kids' club, and entertainment zones are conveniently located nearby.
  • Benefit from its prominent location with easy access to beach clubs and sports grounds.

location_tile.title: In the heart of Palm Jumeirah
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled in a dreamy setting on the serene shores of Palm Jumeirah's West Crescent, SLS Residences at Palm Jumeirah offers a captivating retreat with sweeping vistas of the water, the Dubai Marina skyline, and the iconic Palm Jumeirah itself.

The lush gardens and public spaces have been meticulously designed by Cracknell, a renowned global firm known for their expertise in landscape architecture, planning, and urban design. Their imaginative touch brings an enchanting ambiance to this exceptional development.

Areas Nearby:

  • Burj Khalifa 20 minutes
  • Dubai Al Makhtoum Airport  35 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport 25 minutes
  • Dubai Marina 15 minutes
  • Mall of the Emirates 15 minutes
  • Nakheel Mall 5 minutes
